description: Command-line client for Grimoire, the self-hosted Vault & Configuration Manager: read secrets, export configuration to .env or JSON, and run a process with its secrets injected as environment variables.

C# source generators for Sphere10 Framework that generate boilerplate at compile time. Includes the AutoDirty generator that implements partial properties whose setters set a dirty flag when values change.
NUnit extensions and test helpers for Sphere10 Framework projects. Provides reusable utilities intended to simplify writing unit and integration tests across framework components.

Database testing helpers for Sphere10.Framework.Data and provider packages using NUnit. Includes utilities intended for repeatable integration tests against supported databases such as SQLite and SQL Server.
Web models and utilities independent of ASP.NET Core: HTML formatting, animation classes, sitemaps, navigation, messages, and DataTables models.
Sphere10 Framework Blazor components, application shells, dialogs, wizards and data grids.
ASP.NET Core MVC extensions for Sphere10 Framework: controllers, Razor HTML helpers, Bootstrap forms, action filters, routing, and XML and image results.
Render an independent visual object model to HTML and plain text, using embedded themes and optional asset and template overrides.
Windows Forms charting controls imported from the legacy Microsoft DataVisualization project and its maintained continuation, with line, bar, column and other charts and DPI support for modern .NET.

Windows Store distribution support for Sphere10 Framework applications. Provides the product updater that checks the Microsoft Store for package updates and hands their installation to the Store, selected at build time for Store distributions.
.NET client for the Levelmaster realtime tank-telemetry stream. Authenticates with an API client id and secret and receives durable, replayable reading updates over SignalR.

Zharp for Godot .NET (C#) games, with the Zharp Godot addon: ZharpGodot.Start(this) reports C# exceptions that end the game (saved to disk and sent on the next launch), HttpClient calls and, with logs on, ILogger lines, on the same session, device, scene and player as the addon's GDScript errors.

Zharp for .NET MAUI: builder.UseZharp() reports crashes (saved to disk and sent on the next launch), UI hangs, pages as screens, sessions and a device ID, with an offline queue, on Android, iOS, Mac Catalyst and Windows. Add Zharp.Build so release stacks get their lines.

Zharp for WPF and Windows Forms apps: ZharpApp.Start() reports crashes (saved to disk and sent on the next launch), UI hangs, windows and forms as screens, sessions and a device ID, with an offline queue. Add Zharp.Build so release stacks get their lines.
MCP server for Reglet: lets AI agents create, convert, read, fill and validate DOCX, ODT, PDF, HTML and XLSX files, with no Office or LibreOffice installed.
dotnet tool that scans .NET Framework 4.x solutions and reports migration blockers (System.Web, WCF, incompatible packages) with an effort estimate for modern .NET.
Analysis engine of Legacy Migration Scanner: detects .NET Framework to modern .NET migration blockers and estimates effort.
Model Context Protocol tools and prompts for Legacy Migration Scanner (hosted by `lms mcp`).
A WebSocket tunnel for StackExchange.Redis connections.

Render dynamic XFA forms (XML Forms Architecture, from Adobe LiveCycle Designer) to ordinary PDF pages with RaiCore.Pdf: the form's data merged into its template, laid out with flowed and positioned subforms, tables, repeating subforms and pagination, with the field values formatted and flattened.
